notes: Ethereum mainnet launch of Swarmlings (LING) paired with IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7). Swarmlings is a DN404 token: its zero-argument constructor deploys its NFT contract (SwarmlingsMirror) and mints exactly 1e27 to msg.sender with skipNFT set; every whole 300,000 LING held by a wallet is one Swarmling NFT (3,333 max), minted and burned automatically; contracts skip NFTs unless they opt in (EIP-7702 delegated wallets count as wallets), so the factory, PoolManager and distributor never hold any. The token has no admin, proxy, pause, mint after construction, or fee on transfer; owner() only names the marketplace collection editor and has no power in the contracts; anyone may burn their own LING. SwarmlingsHook takes the PoolManager and the token; all 14 hook flags are set (address low bits 0x3FFF) because it is a router ('the Hive') to which financial primitives can be attached after launch: slices (extra fee to sinks, total fee capped at 5%) and modules (guards on buys, gas-capped observers, fee quoters). Only SwarmlingsCouncil at the CREATE2 address 0x4d0b3507D80f678d9e658Fd5482Ca6a96636A032 (constant COUNCIL; owner = the dev wallet; changes apply at once with a logged memo; deployed by us separately) can change them; at launch there are no slices and no modules. Launch protection is a constant snipe tax: for 60 seconds after the pool opens, buys pay an extra fee falling linearly from 40% to 0, all to NFT holders; sells are exempt. On chain id 1 the token's rewardCurrency is IMD, and the first IMD / LING pool at static fee 12500 becomes launchPool (tick spacing 60 requested); every other IMD / LING pool with the hook pays the same holder fee, modules run only on the launch pool. A 1.25% IMD fee on every buy and sell goes entirely to NFT holders, paid out day by day, on top of the pool's 1.25% LP fee. NFT sales carry a 5% ERC-2981 creator fee to the token (half to holders in ETH, half to DEV 0x92cEf4823119f3332A85A39023eEbA01a06890c4) with OpenSea's fixed transfer validator. initialPrice follows the existing IMD-paired manifests (2^96); the pool opens at the launcher's policy cap for IMD (2,500 IMD). Requested economics: poolBps 9000, so no allocation goes to the requester (an EOA allocation of 100M LING would mint 333 NFTs inside the launch transaction). Creation gas on mainnet: about 4.3M for the token with its NFT contract and about 4.6M for the hook (21.7 KB runtime). Art comes from an immutable renderer at the same CREATE2 address on every chain (0x8d79e6677FA6E52190B39096f8496628811D8281, source in renderer/); until it has code, tokenURI returns a minimal valid JSON. See README.md and docs/.
